name: Two-tier app
description: A web server and a private database server that can find each other.

fields.startup_script:
#!/bin/sh # Clutter puts the database server's private address in CLUTTER_DB_ADDRESS. mkdir -p /etc/app echo "DATABASE_HOST=$CLUTTER_DB_ADDRESS" > /etc/app/database.env # Serve a page on port 80 with what the image has: python3 (Amazon Linux, # Ubuntu), else busybox httpd, else a busybox nc loop (cirros). dir=/var/www/clutter mkdir -p "$dir" page() { printf '%s

%s

%s

\n' "$1" "$1" "$2" > "$dir/index.html"; } page web "Checking that web reaches db." cd "$dir" if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then nohup python3 -m http.server 80 >/var/log/clutter-web.log 2>&1 & elif busybox --list 2>/dev/null | grep -qx httpd; then busybox httpd -p 80 -h "$dir" else while true; do { printf 'HTTP/1.0 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/html\r\n\r\n'; cat "$dir/index.html"; } | nc -l -p 80 >/dev/null 2>&1; done & fi # Check that this server reaches the database server, and say so on the page and the console. result="web could not reach db" i=0 while [ "$i" -lt 30 ]; do if ping -c 1 -W 2 "$CLUTTER_DB_ADDRESS" >/dev/null 2>&1; then result="web reached db" break fi i=$((i + 1)) sleep 5 done page web "$result" echo "$result" echo "$result" >/dev/console 2>/dev/null

#!/bin/sh
# Install PostgreSQL where the image has a package manager for it.
if command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dnf install -y postgresql15-server && postgresql-setup --initdb && systemctl enable --now postgresql
elif command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apt-get update && apt-get install -y postgresql
fi
